Dutch Functional Programming Day 2027

January 8th 2027 - Utrecht
<https://wouter-swierstra.github.io/fp-dag>

The Dutch Functional Programming Day (also known as the FP Dag) is an annual gathering of researchers, students, and practitioners sharing a common interest in functional programming, including Lean and other proof assistants.

The day features talks that cover the latest advances in research, teaching, and applications in functional programming in the broadest sense. Coffee and lunch breaks provide ample opportunity for networking with your colleagues and meeting new people. Experts and newcomers to the field are equally welcome.

When and where

The FP Dag will take place on January 8th 2027, in the Boothzaal of the Utrecht University’s Library on the Utrecht Science Park. There is a tram stop nearby with regular connections to and from Utrecht CS.

Talks

If you would like to offer a talk, please reach out to

Wouter Swierstra (w.s.swierstra@uu.nl)

Dinner

We will end the day with a joint dinner (at your own expense). We will provide more information about the dinner plans later.

Registration

Registration is free of charge, but please register before December 18th using the link below:

https://edu.nl/ygkvt

Lunch and coffee will be provided.
